items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: I was with him for two years when he decided to organize a band. And we went from town to town to play.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you join Jelly Roll in playing in a band or anything with him ever? Did you ever play with him?

Oh, yes. Yeah, I mentioned that. I was with him for two years when he decided to organize a band. And we went from town to town to play. And we played around Los Angeles and various places. We were, as a band of six of us. We were trying to operate a place. It was called Leakes Lake.
Oh, yeah. That was down in Watts, wasn't it?
